execution_contract: SOURCE / DESIGN OBJECT -> OPERATION INTENT -> OWNER / MASK -> OPERATOR CLASS -> PARAMETERS -> NON-DESTRUCTIVE STATE -> EFFECT-OFF BASELINE -> EXPORT / RUNTIME -> ACTUAL READBACK -> REVIEW

parameters.svg: blur .42 -> grayscale -> 8 discrete tonal bands -> restrained neutral-green matrix

operations.off_state: raw source image / filter:none / tonal overlay hidden
operations.role: compress digital photographic continuity into restrained matte tonal masses without replacing the source
operations.does_not_prove: ink material, field condition, geometry, weather or site survey

operations.owner: left page-to-image transition + whole plate paper veil

parameters.mask: five asymmetric elliptical Bone Mist wash fields + low bottom density
parameters.paper_veil: micro radial/linear texture + 0.105 Bone Mist veil
parameters.mobile: reduced mask, no desktop left wash transfer

operations.off_state: wash mask and paper veil hidden
operations.role: replace uniform digital gradient with bounded irregular page absorption
operations.does_not_prove: missing landscape content or altered source extent

operations.owner: main karst silhouettes + bounded river/shore relation
operations.role: add a second-read structural ink edge only where the landscape relation benefits
operations.does_not_prove: line drawing authority, surveyed contour, cadastral or route geometry

hard_boundaries: RASTER PREVIEW != AUTHORITATIVE VECTOR / TEXT / GEOMETRY
same source remains one project-wide semantic Web image slot
